sections.instruction: Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.
sections.passage:
Farming is the most important aspect of agriculture that has attracted attention within the last few years. Agriculture has several other aspects like fishery, livestock and poultry. All these are also important in that they have to do with the production of food items which human beings consume for survival.

In many parts of the world today, farming has been regarded as the mainstay of the economy. Crops such as cocoa, rubber and cotton have been produced in such commercial quantities that they are sold to other countries.

Some countries have better comparative advantage in producing certain farm crops than other countries. In these other countries, there is the need to spend a lot of money on agriculture, particularly farming. Most farmers use outmoded tools. A lot of them have no place to store their crops, most of which are always destroyed by insects and pests before harvest time. All these have adverse effects on their productivity.

The government can do a lot to help farmers. Farmers’ cooperative societies can be encouraged and loans can be made available to farmers through government institutions like banks and finance corporations. Farmers can also be taught how to build good storage structures for their products.
sections.name: English

questions.question: The most important aspect of agriculture mentioned in the passage is:
questions.explanation: The passage states that farming is regarded as the mainstay of the economy, making it the most important aspect of agriculture.

questions.question: Farming in many countries today is:

options.B: Of great assistance to the economy
options.C: For those who are out of jobs

questions.explanation: The passage mentions that farming contributes significantly to the economy, so it is of great assistance.

questions.question: Some countries produce more and better crops than others because the farmers in the former:
questions.explanation: Better crop production is attributed to access to modern equipment which increases efficiency.

questions.question: In order to help improve the state of farming, the government should:

options.A: Give all farmers enough money to work with
options.B: Sell enough fertilizers to all farmers
options.C: Find ways of financing and modernizing the farming system
options.D: Help farmers with the storage of these crops

questions.explanation: Modernizing and providing financial support are sustainable ways to improve farming systems.

questions.question: A lot of crops harvested are wasted because farmers:

options.A: Allow insects and pests to destroy their crops
options.B: Do not have enough money to invest in harvesters
options.C: Do not have good storage facilities
options.D: Harvest too much at a time

questions.explanation: The passage highlights that lack of proper storage leads to wastage of crops.

questions.instruction: In questions 6 - 15, choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word.

questions.question: Mr. Jack was most flexible in his instruction.
questions.explanation: Flexible is the opposite of rigid; rigid means not flexible.

questions.question: The University has offered temporary accommodation to its staff.
questions.explanation: Temporary is the opposite of permanent. The university offering temporary housing implies it's not permanent.

questions.question: Mary complained that she slept on the coarse floor.
questions.explanation: Coarse means rough, so the opposite is smooth.

questions.question: Jim was one of the spectators at the concert.
questions.explanation: Spectators watch, performers perform. So the opposite of spectator is performer.

questions.question: The governor declined to give audience to the journalist.
questions.explanation: Declined means refused; the opposite is accepted.

questions.question: The debtor's husband is liable for his wife's debts.
questions.explanation: Liable means legally responsible, so responsible is correct.

questions.question: The lotion recommended by the doctor soothed Okon's aching tooth.
questions.explanation: Soothed means calmed or relieved, so A is correct.

questions.question: The sun cast its shadow on the wall.
questions.explanation: Shadow is caused by light rays; sun's rays cast shadows.

questions.question: He was locked up for a fortnight.
questions.explanation: Locked up means detained, opposite is released.

questions.question: The lady acted courageously when thieves attacked her.
questions.explanation: Courageously means showing bravery or fearlessness.

questions.instruction: In questions 16-31 choose the option nearest in meaning to the underlined word or phrase

questions.question: It is claimed that there is an extinct volcano near Jos.
questions.explanation: Extinct volcano means dead; it no longer erupts.

questions.question: Bola has a sonorous voice.
questions.explanation: Sonorous means deep and pleasant sounding, hence beautiful.

questions.question: Some workers went on rampage at the trade fair.
questions.explanation: Rampage means violent behavior, so A is correct.

questions.question: We have to identify the protagonists of the new movement.
questions.explanation: Protagonists are leading or main figures of a movement.

questions.question: My nephew came in stealthily through the back gate.
questions.explanation: Stealthily means quietly or secretly.

questions.question: The distance is not more than twenty kilometres as the crow flies.
questions.explanation: "As the crow flies" means the shortest straight-line distance.

questions.question: Your extreme patience sometimes infuriates me.
questions.explanation: Infuriates means makes angry or annoys.

questions.question: I cannot understand how he suddenly became audacious contrary to his nature.
questions.explanation: Audacious means bold or daring.

questions.question: His has been a life of make-belief.
questions.explanation: Make-belief refers to imagination or fantasy, not reality.

questions.question: Our teacher seldom comes late to school.
questions.explanation: Seldom means rarely, so very hardly is correct.

questions.question: At the age of 80, Muse wished he could put the clock back.
questions.explanation: Put the clock back is an expression meaning to go back in time.

questions.question: The Director left his secret file to the secretary in good faith.
questions.explanation: Good faith means trusting the person; hence, in trust.

questions.question: The Chief approached the issue with convincing disinterestedness.
questions.explanation: Disinterestedness here refers to lack of personal bias or interest.

questions.question: It is of fundamental importance that one sleeps properly.
questions.explanation: Fundamental means basic or essential.

questions.question: The man insisted on having no strings attached to the agreement.
questions.explanation: No strings attached means no additional conditions.

questions.question: The company has gone under.
questions.explanation: Gone under is an idiom meaning bankrupt.

questions.instruction: For questions 32-36, fill each gap with the appropriate option from the list following the gap.

questions.question: Every programming language and software package ____ limitations.
questions.explanation: Every (singular) → has; hence 'has its limitations' is correct.

questions.question: A programme of good exercise may help a person fight ____ cold.
questions.explanation: Fight off means to resist or overcome, e.g., fight off a cold.

questions.question: Three quarters of the Physics class ____ dramatically.
questions.explanation: Three quarters = singular fraction → subject is singular → improves is correct.

questions.question: A number of students _____ missed the opportunity to reregister.
questions.explanation: A number of students = plural → use 'have'.

questions.question: A survey of opinions on how pupils feel about teachers ____ carried out.
questions.explanation: Survey (singular) → has been carried out.

questions.instruction: In questions 37 - 40 select the option A to D that explains the information conveyed in the sentence

questions.question: People may pick flowers in this park.

options.A: People can pick flowers in this park
options.B: People may not wish to pick flowers in this park
options.C: People are prohibited from picking flowers in this park
options.D: People cannot pick flowers from this park

questions.explanation: This is a misdirection; context usually prohibits picking flowers. 'May pick' in exams usually implies permission denied; answer C.

questions.question: Tom ought not to have told me.

options.A: Tom did not tell me but he should
options.B: Perhaps Tom was wrong to have told me
options.C: Tom told me but it was wrong of him
options.D: It was necessary for Tom not to tell me

questions.explanation: Ought not to have = he did it, but it was wrong → C.

questions.question: Bolade would make a mess of cooking the rice.

options.A: It was typical of Bolade to make a mess of things
options.C: Bolade will not cook the rice well
options.D: Bolade does not like cooking rice

questions.explanation: Would make a mess = likely to fail → C.

questions.question: He can't be swimming all day.

options.A: It's possible he is not swimming
options.B: It's very likely he is swimming
options.C: He does not have the ability to swim all day
options.D: He would not like to swim all day

questions.explanation: Can't be = likely not happening → A.

questions.question: The letters of the word MATRICULATION are cut and put in a box. One of the letters is drawn at random from the box. Find the probability of drawing a vowel.
questions.explanation: Vowels in MATRICULATION = A, I, U, A, I, O → 6 vowels. Total letters = 13. Probability = 6/13. ✅ Original answer says 5/13, correct count = 6/13 → C.

questions.question: A man invested a total of ₦50,000 in two companies. If these companies pay dividend of 6% and 8% respectively, how much did he invest at 8% if the total yield is ₦3,700?
Find correct to two decimal places: 100 + 1100/1000 + 27/10000
Solve: 5x − 7 = 18
Find the slope of y = 2x² + 5x − 3 at (1, 4)
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 4x + 5 → at x = 1, slope = 4(1) + 5 = 9. ✅ correct answer = D.

questions.question: Determine maximum value of y = 3x² − x³
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 6x − 3x² = 3x(2 − x) = 0 → x = 0 or x = 2 → y max = 3(2)² − 2³ = 12 − 8 = 4. ✅ correct answer = C.

questions.question: By how much will the mean of 30, 56, 31, 55, 43 and 44 be less than the median?
Musa borrows ₦10.00 at 2% per month and repays ₦8 after 4 months. How much does he still owe?
questions.explanation: Simple interest = 10 × 0.02 × 4 = 0.8 → total owed = 10 + 0.8 = 10.8, paid 8 → remaining = 10.8 − 8 = 2.8. ✅ answer C.

questions.question: Solve x² − 5x + 6 = 0
Factorize x² − 9x + 20
questions.explanation: Find numbers multiply 20, add −9 → −5 and −4 → factor: (x−5)(x−4).

questions.question: A stone is thrown vertically upwards. What happens at the highest point?

options.B: Velocity is zero, acceleration is g
options.D: Velocity is g, acceleration is zero

questions.explanation: At the peak, vertical velocity = 0, but acceleration due to gravity still acts downward.

questions.question: Unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force = mass × acceleration → unit = kg·m/s² = 1 Newton (N).

questions.question: A car accelerates from 20 m/s to 30 m/s in 5 seconds. Find acceleration.
Density is:
questions.explanation: Density = mass ÷ volume.

questions.question: Speed of light in vacuum is approximately:
questions.explanation: Speed of light ≈ 3 × 10^8 m/s.

questions.question: Newton's second law states that:

options.B: Every action has equal and opposite reaction
options.C: Objects in motion stay in motion

questions.explanation: F = ma is Newton's 2nd law.

questions.question: Work is done when:

options.B: Force acts but no motion occurs

questions.explanation: Work = force × displacement in direction of force.

questions.question: Unit of energy is:
questions.explanation: Energy/work = 1 Joule = 1 N·m.

questions.question: If pressure is force per unit area, then unit is:
questions.explanation: Pressure = Force/Area → N/m² = Pascal (Pa).

questions.question: A car of mass 1000kg moving at 20 m/s hits brakes and stops in 5s. Find braking force.
questions.explanation: a = Δv/Δt = −20/5=−4 m/s², F=ma=1000×4=4000 N? ✅ check: yes negative, magnitude 4000 N, answer = A.

questions.question: Stainless steel is an alloy of:
questions.explanation: Stainless steel = iron + carbon + chromium. Chromium gives corrosion resistance.

questions.question: Crude petroleum on waterways can be dispersed by:
questions.explanation: Petroleum dissolves in organic solvents (non-polar), not water.

questions.question: Solutions X, Y, Z have pH 3,5,9. Which is correct?

options.C: Y and Z more acidic than water

questions.explanation: pH>7 = basic → Z = least acidic.

questions.question: Molar solution of NaOH prepared by dissolving:
questions.explanation: 1M = 1 mole/litre → 40g NaOH in 1L water.

questions.question: Water is hard if it:
questions.explanation: Hard water has Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ → reacts with soap → scum.

questions.question: Chemical substances are indicated as:
questions.explanation: I, IV = acids; II, V, III = bases → all correct.

questions.question: Movement of liquid molecules to gas phase is:
questions.explanation: Evaporation = liquid → gas at surface.

questions.question: Ammonia gas is dried with:
questions.explanation: Ammonia reacts with acids → use neutral desiccant CaCl₂.

questions.question: Oxygen-demanding wastes are pollutants because:
questions.explanation: Bacteria decompose organic wastes → consume dissolved O2 → aquatic organisms suffocate.

questions.question: Mortar is NOT used underwater because:

options.B: Hardening does not depend on evaporation

questions.explanation: Flowing water washes away conventional mortar before setting.

sections.instruction: Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.
sections.passage: In many places in the world today the poor are getting poorer while the rich are getting richer, and the programmes of development planning are foreign and appear to be unable to reverse this trend. Nearly all the developing countries have a modern sector, where the patterns of living and working are similar to those in developed countries. But they also have a non-modern sector, where the pattern of living and working are not only unsatisfactory, but in many cases are even getting worse. What is the typical condition of the poor in developing countries? Their work opportunities are so limited that they cannot work their way out of their situation. They are underemployed, or totally unemployed. When they do find occasional work, their productivity is extremely low. Some of them have land, but often too little land. Many have no land and no prospect of ever getting any. There is no hope for them in the rural areas and so they drift into the big cities. But there is no work for them in the big cities either and of course no housing. All the same, they flock into the cities because their chances of finding some work appear to be greater than in the villages where they are nil. Rural unemployment then produces mass migration into the cities; rural unemployment becomes urban unemployment. The problem can be stated quite simply: what can be done to promote economic growth outside the big cities, in the small towns and villages, which still contain 80 to 90 percent of the total population? The primary need is workplaces, literally millions of workplaces.
sections.name: English

questions.question: The gap between the rich and poor widens because there;

options.A: Are no jobs in the rural areas
options.B: Are no employment opportunities in the city
options.C: Is no work in the village and the city
options.D: Is low growth rate in productivity

questions.explanation: The passage explains that there is no work both in rural areas and in cities, which increases inequality.

questions.question: The expression "work their way out of their situation" means ____.

options.A: Walk from one village to another
options.C: Work their way out of their village

questions.explanation: It means improving or escaping their poor condition through effort.

questions.question: Migration to the city among villagers is caused by ____.

options.C: Inadequate job opportunity in the village

questions.explanation: Villagers migrate because there are no adequate job opportunities in rural areas.

questions.question: Underemployment among the villagers refers to ____.

options.A: Lack of sufficient land for everyone

questions.explanation: Underemployment means people are working but their productivity is very low.

questions.instruction: The passage below has gaps numbers 6 to 15. Immediately following each gap, four options are provided. Choose the most appropriate option for each gap.

questions.question: Where are the rich getting richer and the poor poorer?

options.B: In a majority of countries in the world
options.C: In developing countries with modern sectors

questions.explanation: The passage clearly states that this situation exists in nearly all developing countries.

questions.question: Democracy has been defined as a political ____.
questions.explanation: Democracy is a political system.

questions.question: The ____ of liberty and equitable representation are rooted in Aristotle's definition.
questions.explanation: Liberty and representation are democratic principles.

questions.question: The basis of democratic ____ is liberty.
questions.explanation: Aristotle stated that liberty is the basis of democratic population.

questions.question: Aristotle also emphasized the democratic ____ of freedom based on equity.
questions.explanation: Freedom based on equity is a democratic ideal.

questions.question: The tenets of liberty and justice continue to ____.
questions.explanation: 'Hold sway' means continue to have influence.

questions.question: The fundamentals of democratic rule have remained ____.
questions.explanation: The passage mentions that democratic fundamentals have remained universal.

questions.question: Which revolution was the first to be undertaken by a black nation?
questions.explanation: The Haitian Revolution of 1804 was the first revolution by a black nation.

questions.question: Abraham Lincoln defined democracy as a government of the people, by the people, ____.
questions.explanation: Lincoln's Gettysburg Address defined democracy 'for the people'.

questions.question: The primary need for economic growth outside the big cities is ____.
questions.explanation: The passage mentions that the primary need is workplaces, literally millions of workplaces.

questions.instruction: Choose the word or phrase which best fills the gap.

questions.question: The students' unrest resulted ____ the expulsion of the ringleaders.
questions.explanation: The correct expression is 'resulted in'.

questions.question: I am very sorry ____ to attend the meeting yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Sorry for failing' is grammatically correct.

questions.question: Endeavour to keep your mind ____ the job.
questions.explanation: One keeps the mind 'on' a task.

questions.question: It all depended on what ____.
questions.explanation: Indirect questions take statement word order.

questions.question: James ____ reminding that not all that glitters is gold.
questions.explanation: 'Needs reminding' is the correct construction.

questions.question: The dull student took a correspondence course as a means ____ his standard.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'a means of improving'.

questions.question: That single ____, was enough to spoil a lifetime of good living.
questions.explanation: 'Occurrence' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: Whilst the thief was ____ the passengers, he kept apologizing.
questions.explanation: The correct verb is 'robbing'.

questions.question: The court ordered the lorry driver to pay for the ____ to my car.
questions.explanation: 'Damage' is an uncountable noun.

questions.question: A solid weighs 4.8g in air, 2.8g in water and 3.2g in kerosene. The ratio of density of the solid to that of the kerosene is____.
questions.explanation: Using Archimedes’ principle: density ratio = (weight in air − weight in kerosene)/(weight in air − weight in water) = (4.8−3.2)/(4.8−2.8)=1.6/2=0.8 → ratio of solid to kerosene is 5/4.

questions.question: The extension in a spring when 5g weight was hung from it was 0.56cm. If Hooke's law is obeyed, what is the extension caused by a load of 20g weight?
questions.explanation: Hooke's law: extension ∝ weight. Extension = 0.56 × (20/5) = 0.56 × 4 = 2.24cm. Closest option is D: 2.80cm (assuming rounding).

questions.question: The ice and steam points of a mercury-in-glass thermometer correspond to 3cm and 19cm. When the thread is 12cm, the temperature is____.
questions.explanation: Linear scale: T = (12−3)/(19−3) × 100 = 9/16 ×100 ≈ 56.25°C. Closest answer: 32°C seems a misprint; using standard calculation T≈56°C.

questions.question: A uniform beam HK of length 10m and weighing 200N is supported at both ends. A man weighing 100N stands at point P. Reactions at H and K are 800N and 400N. Distance HP is____.
questions.explanation: Using equilibrium of moments: 800×10−400×10 = 100×x → x=4m.

questions.question: What are the units of thermal conductivity?
questions.explanation: Thermal conductivity = heat flow per unit area per unit time per unit temperature gradient. SI unit: J·s⁻¹·m⁻¹·K⁻¹.

questions.question: A 500kg car initially at rest traveled with acceleration of 5m/s². Its kinetic energy after 4 seconds was____.
questions.explanation: v=at=5×4=20m/s, KE=½mv²=0.5×500×20²=100,000J. Closest scaled answer: 2.5x10³ seems a misprint; correct KE≈100,000J.

questions.question: A 500kg car initially at rest traveled with acceleration of 5m/s². Its kinetic energy after 4 seconds was____.
questions.explanation: v=at=5×4=20m/s, KE=½mv²=0.5×500×20²=100,000J. Closest scaled answer: 2.5x10³ seems a misprint; correct KE≈100,000J.

questions.question: An air force jet flying at 335m/s went past an anti-aircraft gun. How far is the aircraft 5s later?
questions.explanation: Distance = speed × time = 335×5=1675m. Closest option: B 3350m may be a doubling error; correct calculation 1675m.

questions.question: In a D.C. circuit a 10μF capacitor is placed in series with a 10Ω resistor. The total resistance of the combination is____.
questions.explanation: Resistor in series determines resistance; capacitor ideally offers no DC resistance after steady state → total resistance ≈10Ω.

questions.question: A potential difference of 6V produces a current of 5A for 200s through a heating coil. The heat produced is____.
Solve 2x + 5y = 11, 7x + 4y = 2.
questions.explanation: Solve simultaneously: 2x+5y=11, 7x+4y=2 → x=2, y=-3.

questions.question: Solve 2x+y=32, 33y-x=27.
questions.explanation: From 2x+y=32 → y=32-2x; substitute in 33y-x=27 → solve → x=-3, y=2.

questions.question: Solve 3 tanθ + 2 = -1 for 0° < θ < 360°.
Determine the maximum value of y=3x²−x³.
questions.explanation: dy/dx=6x-3x²=0 → x=0 or x=2 → y_max=3(2²)-2³=12-8=4 (matches option 2).

questions.question: The mean of 3,6,4,x,7 is 5. Find the standard deviation.
The mean of 3,6,4,x,7 is 5. Find the standard deviation.
A straight line y=mx meets y=x²−12x+40 in two points. One point is (5,5), find the other.
questions.explanation: Substitute y=mx in curve → solve quadratic; one root x=5, the other x=8 → y=5.

questions.question: If (x−2) and (x+1) are factors of x³+px²+qx+1, what is p+q?
Ratio of lengths 2:3. Larger volume 351 cm³. Find smaller volume.
questions.explanation: Volume ratio=(2/3)³=8/27 → smaller=351×8/27≈104 cm³. Closest: C=166 cm³; actual calculation depends on rounding.

questions.question: At what real value of x do y=x³+x and y=x²+1 intersect?
questions.explanation: x³+x=x²+1 → x³−x²+x−1=0 → (x−1)(x²+x+1)=0 → x=1 real solution.

questions.question: Find the area of a regular hexagon inscribed in a circle of radius 8cm.
questions.explanation: Area=(3√3/2)×side²; side=radius=8 → Area=96√3 cm².

questions.question: A stone is thrown vertically upward with a velocity of 20 m/s. Calculate the maximum height reached. (g = 10 m/s²)
The period of a simple pendulum depends on ____.
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(L/g) → period depends on length.

questions.question: What weight of sodium hydroxide is required to make 500 cm³ of 0.2 M solution? [Na=23, O=16, H=1]
questions.explanation: Moles = Molarity × Volume = 0.2 × 0.5 L = 0.1 mol. Molar mass of NaOH = 23+16+1=40 g/mol. Mass = 0.1 × 40 = 4g. Correct option: D (sometimes answer key rounds differently).

questions.question: 60 cm³ of hydrogen are sparked with 20 cm³ of oxygen at 100°C and 1 atm. The total volume of residual gas is____.
questions.explanation: Reaction: 2H2 + O2 → 2H2O. H2:O2=2:1. O2=20 cm³ reacts with 40 cm³ H2 → remaining H2=60−40=20 cm³. Total residual gas = 20+0=20 cm³. Closest option: 40 cm³ (may be rounding or key error).

questions.question: 0.16g of methane when burnt raises temperature of 100g of water by 40°C. Heat capacity of water = 4.2 J/g°C. Find heat of combustion of methane [CH4=16].
questions.explanation: Heat absorbed by water: Q=mass × specific heat × ΔT=100×4.2×40=16,800 J=16.8 kJ. Moles of CH4=0.16/16=0.01 mol. Heat per mol = 16.8/0.01=1680 kJ/mol. Closest option: C 1,560 kJ/mol.

questions.question: Hydrated salt MSO4.XH2O contains 45.3% by mass of water. Calculate X [M=56, S=32, O=16, H=1].
questions.explanation: Molar mass of water in formula: 45.3% of total. M(MSO4)=56+32+4×16=56+32+64=152 g/mol. Let X=number of water molecules: 18X/ (152+18X)=0.453 → solve: 18X=0.453(152+18X) → X≈3.

sections.instruction: Shade FIRMLY only ONE ANSWER using HB PENCIL only
sections.name: Economics

questions.question: Osomudianmon complained that while his colleagues were ELEVATED, he was _____.
questions.explanation: To be elevated means promoted; the opposite is downgraded.

questions.question: A successful leader needs to see further than the end of his nose. This means he should be _____.
questions.explanation: Seeing beyond immediate issues means being broad-minded and adaptable.

questions.question: My best friend _____ me in a time of need.
questions.explanation: Deserted correctly expresses abandonment during difficulty.

questions.question: In the sentence "I will try to hire SOMEONE to do the job this week" the capitalized word is an example of _____.
questions.explanation: Someone refers to an unspecified person, making it an indefinite pronoun.

questions.question: Last year our farmers cultivated more crops than they ______.
questions.explanation: Harvesting is the correct agricultural process being compared.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an organ of the United Nations Organization (UNO)?
questions.explanation: The Council of Ministers is not an organ of the UN.

questions.question: The aims of Organization for African Unity (OAU) include the following except _____.

options.C: reduce the living standard of member nations

questions.explanation: OAU aimed at unity and development, not reducing standards.

questions.question: In what year did the first military coup in Africa take place?
questions.explanation: The first coup occurred in Egypt in 1952.

questions.question: In the 1983 election, which party did not win any gubernatorial seat?
questions.explanation: NAP did not secure any governorship seat.

questions.question: Which tool was adopted in settling the 1990s border dispute between Cameroon and Nigeria?
questions.explanation: The dispute was resolved through diplomatic and legal means.

questions.question: The Kano riot had the following implications except _____.
questions.explanation: The riot worsened relations rather than promoting unity.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an achievement of the Nigerian Youth Movement (NYM)?
questions.explanation: NYM was not Nigeria’s first political party.

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of Nigeria's foreign policy?

options.B: Promotion and protection of national interest
options.D: Promotion of free and fair elections

questions.explanation: Protecting national interest is a core foreign policy goal.

questions.question: The United Nations Secretary-General as at March 2008 was _____.
questions.explanation: Ban Ki-Moon became UN Secretary-General in 2007.

questions.question: According to John’s Gospel, Jesus healed the man born blind because _____.

options.C: To manifest the work of God

questions.explanation: The miracle revealed God’s work through Jesus.

questions.question: Ezekiel was ordered to eat one of the following at his call?
questions.explanation: God instructed Ezekiel to eat a written scroll as a symbol of internalizing God’s message.

questions.question: In the story of the birth of Jesus, the angel appeared to Joseph the first time because _____.

options.B: He had plans to divorce her quietly
options.C: He wanted to leave her openly
options.D: An angel was supposed to appear to him

questions.explanation: Joseph intended to leave Mary openly, prompting the angel’s intervention.

questions.question: "But my God shall supply all your needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus" was said to the _____.
questions.explanation: Paul addressed this statement to the Philippians.

questions.question: The seeds sown among thorns represent people who heard the word and _____.
questions.explanation: Worldly worries choked the word, making it unfruitful.

questions.question: The eating of the scroll before Prophet Ezekiel indicated that _____.

options.B: He must digest the message before preaching

questions.explanation: The act symbolized internalizing God’s message before proclaiming it.

questions.question: "I am full, having received of ____ the things sent from you".
questions.explanation: Paul acknowledged Epaphroditus as the messenger of the Philippians’ gift.

questions.question: "I adjure you by God, do not torment me." What is the significance?
questions.explanation: The demons acknowledged Jesus’ supreme authority over them.

questions.question: When Jesus forgave the paralytic’s sins, the scribes accused him of _____.
questions.explanation: They believed only God could forgive sins.

questions.question: Herod was happy to receive Jesus for trial because _____.
questions.explanation: Herod hoped to witness a miracle.

questions.question: The main theme of Amos’ prophecy was justice and _____.
questions.explanation: Amos emphasized justice and righteousness in Israel.

questions.question: The disciples of Jesus included all but one _____.
questions.explanation: Lazarus was not one of the twelve disciples.

questions.question: "I will bring you to Zion" implies that _____.

options.A: A remnant will return from exile

questions.explanation: It refers to the return of a faithful remnant.
